runner_tagline.message: Runs the tests a team instance asks for, on this machine.
runner_tagline.description: Under the app's name, at the top of the window: what Piwi Runner does.

runner_connectionHeading.description: Heading of the card that connects Piwi Runner to a team instance. The feature's name on the instance's pages.

runner_runsHeading.description: Heading of the list of the runs this window started.

runner_noRuns.message: No runs yet. When a team instance asks for tests, you confirm them here first.
runner_noRuns.description: In place of the list of runs, while there is none.

runner_statusRunning.description: Badge of a run: its tests are running.

runner_statusPassed.description: Badge of a run: every test passed.

runner_statusFailed.description: Badge of a run: a test failed.

runner_statusStopped.description: Badge of a run: the person stopped it before it ended.

runner_statusError.description: Badge of a run: it could not start, or Playwright ended with an error.

runner_stopping.description: Badge of a run, and label of its Stop button, once Stop was clicked and the run has not ended yet.

runner_stopNow.description: Button, once Stop was clicked and the run has not ended yet: ends it at once.

runner_holdFailures.description: Switch of a running run: a failed test waits at its failure for the person to look before the run goes on.

runner_holdFailuresHint.message: A failed test waits here for you to look before the run goes on.
runner_holdFailuresHint.description: Under the Hold failures switch: what it does.

runner_output.description: Summary of the collapsed block that shows a run's terminal output.

runner_stillRunning.message: Still running from before the window reloaded
runner_stillRunning.description: On a run the window has no entry for: it was started before the window reloaded and still runs.

runner_backgroundHeading.description: Heading of the card of the settings that keep Piwi Runner running when its window is closed.

runner_runInBackground.description: Checkbox, and the same item in the tray menu: closing the window keeps Piwi Runner in the tray.

runner_runInBackgroundHint.message: Closing the window keeps Piwi Runner in the tray: the instance reaches this machine only while it runs. Turned off, closing the window quits it.
runner_runInBackgroundHint.description: Under the Run in background checkbox: what it does.

runner_startOnLogin.description: Checkbox, and the same item in the tray menu: Piwi Runner starts when the person signs in to their computer.

runner_startOnLoginHint.message: Starts Piwi Runner in the tray when you sign in.
runner_startOnLoginHint.description: Under the Start on login checkbox: what it does.

runner_saveFailed.description: Title of an error notification: a setting could not be saved. The reason follows below it.
